reference: By Friday she will have booked a fifth appointment at the studio.
sk: Do piatku si zarezervuje piaty termín v štúdiu.
cz: Do pátku si zarezervuje pátý termín ve studiu.
acceptable: By Friday she will have booked {a|her} fifth {appointment|session|slot} at the studio.
By Friday she will have made {a|her} fifth appointment at the studio.
She will have booked {a|her} fifth {appointment|session|slot} at the studio by Friday.
She will have made {a|her} fifth appointment at the studio by Friday.

mistakes.text: By Friday she will book a fifth appointment at the studio.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „By Friday“ znamená, že dej bude hotový do toho času, preto Future Perfect: „will have booked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „By Friday“ znamená, že děj bude hotový do té doby, proto Future Perfect: „will have booked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “By Friday” means the action is complete before then, so use the Future Perfect: “will have booked”.

mistakes.text: By Friday she will have book a fifth appointment at the studio.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „will have“ patrí tretí tvar slovesa: „booked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „will have“ patří třetí tvar slovesa: „booked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “will have” use the past participle: “booked”.

mistakes.text: Until Friday she will have booked a fifth appointment at the studio.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Do piatku“ v zmysle „najneskôr“ je „by Friday“, nie „until Friday“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Do pátku“ ve smyslu „nejpozději“ je „by Friday“, ne „until Friday“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Until” means the action continues up to Friday; for a deadline use “by Friday”.

mistakes.text: By Friday she will be booking a fifth appointment at the studio.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o dej hotový do piatku, nie prebiehajúci, preto Future Perfect: „will have booked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o děj hotový do pátku, ne probíhající, proto Future Perfect: „will have booked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The booking is finished by Friday, not in progress, so use the Future Perfect: “will have booked”.

mistakes.text: By Friday she will have booked fifth appointment at the studio.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pred „fifth appointment“ chýba člen: „a fifth appointment“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Před „fifth appointment“ chybí člen: „a fifth appointment“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An article is missing before “fifth appointment”: “a fifth appointment”.
